method: Complete character including helmet, connected neck, hands and straight sword drawn together; technical extraction/alpha/atlas packing only after drawing. No head/weapon compositing.

specs.prompt:
Production game motion sheet, 2048x2048, EXACTLY FOUR separate full-body poses in a neat 2x2 arrangement. Genuine transparent RGBA with large empty spacing. Each cell contains ONE complete knight WITH head and weapon drawn together. Do not split the neck, paste a head, omit the sword, or make separate floating pieces. No text or labels.
Image 1 is the original approved SX knight design. Image 2 is the newly drawn horizontal-slash pilot clarifying coherent anatomy and a straight sword, not an alternative face. Image 3 shows the exact original helmet. Match this same identity and detail in all 4 poses: polished cobalt/silver armor, slim gold trim, large angular shoulder plates, long blue/black/gold cape; compact blue forehead jewel, narrow cyan eyes, smooth ivory cheek/face plate and pointed chin, swept silver/gold side crests, NO new horns behind the head. Head remains natural-sized and visibly connected to neck/collar/shoulders.
Adult original proportions, same fixed camera front-right 3/4 and consistent body scale across all cells. Avoid edge-on head/profile; face readable and identical. Different real articulated knees, pelvis, torso, shoulders and hands; flowing cape follows each action.
Greatsword: draw it as part of each complete pose with the hand gripping its long black handle, ornate gold sunburst guard and round medallion, long broad ivory/silver blade with a raised straight gold decorative spine. SINGLE STRAIGHT RIGID WEAPON from pommel through handle and guard to tip. Both blade edges are straight, nearly parallel, then symmetrically pointed at the tip. Gold filigree sits on a straight blade; no banana curve, bowed outline, angular break, thin rapier, foreshortened edge view, or floating hand. Keep its same width and length relative to the body in all 4 drawings. No head or weapon collage. Full blade, pommel, helmet, cloak and boots inside EACH cell, at least 7% empty margins, do not overlap neighboring cells. No floor, glow, effects, background, gradients or annotations. Detailed painted game sprite finish like original.
POSES in reading order:
1. Ready grounded pose, knees flexing, sword down-right diagonal 40 degrees, relaxed counterbalance left arm.
2. Weight drops low, rear foot presses the ground, right arm trails behind with the full straight sword pointing back-left, the face looks right.
3. Acceleration launch, rear leg pushes long behind, front knee forward, torso leans 30 degrees, cape streams left, sword trails straight behind left at 170 degrees.
4. Fast low dash, front knee raised and back leg extended, torso leans 35 degrees, sword continues straight back-left, face visible.
